issuer: the Utah Driver License Division (Department of Public Safety)
note: The Driver License Division's fee page (read 2026-10-30) gives an original adult licence (age 21 and over), regular Class D, at $52.00, and the original provisional licence for those 20 and under (a 5-year Class D at $39.00), so a full, non-provisional licence is kept from 21. An identification card is $23.00 with a 5-year expiration. The adult licence's term isn't on the page and wasn't read elsewhere, so it is null. Not held: limited-term licences, the driving privilege card, the 65-and-older renewal.
